XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sporadic unintentional engagement of neutral gear while driving
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: GROUP | GEARBOX | ROBOTISED | P060A | P2917 | TIMES | N | SHIFTS | AUTOMATICALLY | NEUTRAL | CHANGES |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Cars fitted with an automated gearbox

  • System: Gearbox

  • Component: Automated gearbox assembly

  • Fault: Whilst driving, the gearbox occasionally shifts unintentionally into neutral

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • P060A (Engine control unit, main processor module – Fault)
    • P2917 (Electric actuator 6 – Fault)
  • Cause: Faulty automated gearbox assembly

• Action: Check the condition and correct functioning of the robotic gearbox unit; replace if necessary.

  • Procedure:

  • Note: In this case, the defective component did not show any visual abnormalities.
